scenario: My neighborhood has a community garden where residents can harvest their own produce on allotted plots of land. There are currently 20 plots being used. Each resident's plot gets a small weekly water allotment due to strict drought rules, and most have gotten used to gardening with these rules in mind. One morning, while grabbing a wheelbarrow from the shed, I noticed a narrow length of tubing running from the main water source to the back of one gardener's plot, clearly siphoning extra water in secret. It was tucked behind a row of tall tomato cages, easy to miss unless I was standing right there. Her plants looked great, and seeing the setup suddenly made all of that make sense. It was allowing her to use way more water than what was allotted to her by bypassing the water meter. This meant there was far less water available for the other gardeners' plants, not nearly enough to keep them all alive. If I spread rumors about the gardener to the other residents, her excess water usage will stop and the other gardeners' plants will continue to survive. If I do not do this, the plants of 9 other gardeners' plots will die from lack of water.
choice: I decide to spread rumors about the gardener to the other residents
entities: I,the 1 gardener secretly siphoning extra water,the 10 other gardeners using the remaining plots whose plants are not described as dying either way
outcomes: The gardener's excess water use stops
The other gardeners have enough water for their plots
The plants in 9 other gardeners' plots survive
The gardener's reputation among the other residents is damaged
The gardener feels embarrassed and upset
Other residents feel distrust toward the gardener
